title: Fire Code Revision - CFAC Ad Hoc Committee Update - Motion to Support if Amended Letter/CIS
text:
[OLD BUSINESS - DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE MOTIONS]
Fire Code Revision - CFAC Ad Hoc Committee Update - Motion to Support if Amended Letter/CIS
Amendment to Council File 1428 S1 (Independent Scientific Advisory Panel on Zone 0; DRAFT 2027
Annual LAFD Brush Clearance Mailer Text Cyndi Hubach (5 minutes)
summary: The CFAC is considering a motion to support a fire code revision if it is amended, with the amendment tied to an independent scientific advisory panel on Zone 0. The item also covers draft text for the LAFD's 2027 brush clearance mailer.
